answer: The thread holds work receipts rather than names, so the juniper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
